name: Customizable Checkout Experience for Woo Stores
author: Simple Tools

sections.description:
Take full control of your WooCommerce checkout — no code required.

Edit Checkout Fields for WooCommerce by SSP gives you complete control over every field on your checkout page. Add, remove, reorder, and customize billing, shipping, and additional fields with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface. Create custom fields, enable account registration, and streamline your checkout flow.

Stop losing customers to a cluttered or confusing checkout. Show only what you need, in the order you want.

✅ Manage billing, shipping, and additional fields from one interface
✅ Drag-and-drop field reordering
✅ Enable/disable any field with one click
✅ Add unlimited custom fields
✅ 11 field types (text, textarea, select, checkbox, radio, email, phone, number, date, password, heading)
✅ Edit labels, placeholders, CSS classes, and required status
✅ Built-in account creation fields (username, password, confirm password)
✅ Auto-generate passwords and email them to customers
✅ Single form mode — combine all fields into one section
✅ Combine billing and shipping option
✅ Custom fields saved to orders, admin, emails, and confirmations
✅ Real-time password strength indicator
✅ Password match validation
✅ HPOS compatible

What does it do?
This plugin replaces the default WooCommerce checkout field management with a visual editor. Drag fields to reorder, click to enable/disable, and add your own custom fields — all without editing templates or writing code.

Who is this for?
WooCommerce store owners who want to customize their checkout experience, reduce friction, collect additional information, or simplify the purchase process.

Field Types Available:

  • Text
  • Textarea
  • Select/Dropdown
  • Checkbox
  • Radio Buttons
  • Email
  • Phone
  • Number
  • Date Picker
  • Password
  • Section Heading

Account Creation Options:

  • Email as account login
  • Custom username field
  • Password with strength indicator
  • Confirm password with match validation
  • Auto-generated passwords emailed to customers

Stop fighting your checkout. Start controlling it.

Install now and build the checkout your store deserves.

Important Notice

This plugin works with the Classic WooCommerce Checkout (shortcode-based) only. It is NOT compatible with the Block-based checkout editor.

To use, replace your checkout page content with: [woocommerce_checkout]

Third Party Services

This plugin includes links to external services provided by Stupid Simple Plugins. These links are displayed within the plugin admin interface and are only accessed when you choose to click them. No data is automatically transmitted.

Stupid Simple Plugins Website (stupidsimpleplugins.com)

The plugin admin interface contains links to:

  • Documentation pages for plugin help and tutorials
  • Support contact forms for assistance requests
  • Plugin product pages showcasing other available plugins
  • Pricing pages for premium plugin offerings

These links are provided for your convenience to access documentation, support, and additional products. Clicking these links will take you to the Stupid Simple Plugins website.

  • Terms of Service: https://www.stupidsimpleplugins.com/terms-of-service/
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.stupidsimpleplugins.com/privacy-policy/

Privacy

This plugin does not automatically transmit any data to external servers.

All field configurations, settings, and custom field data are stored locally in your WordPress database. No external API calls or data collection occurs during normal plugin operation.

Custom field data entered by customers during checkout is saved to WooCommerce order meta and displayed in the admin order screen, order confirmation page, and order email notifications.

The plugin admin interface contains optional links to Stupid Simple Plugins website for documentation, support, and additional products. These links are only accessed when manually clicked by an administrator.
sections.installation:
1. Upload ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Checkout Fields
  5. Start customizing your checkout fields
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. This plugin is built specifically for WooCommerce stores.

Does it work with the Block checkout?

No. This plugin works with the classic shortcode checkout only. Replace your checkout page content with [woocommerce_checkout] to use the classic checkout.

Can I add custom fields?

Yes. Go to the Additional / Custom tab and click “Add Custom Field” to create text, textarea, select, checkbox, radio, email, phone, number, date, or password fields.

Where do custom fields appear?

Custom fields appear after the order notes on checkout. The data is saved to the order and displayed in admin, order emails, and order confirmations.

Can I enable account creation during checkout?

Yes. Enable the account username, password, and confirm password fields in the Billing tab. Customers can create accounts during checkout.

What is auto-generated password?

When enabled, customers are forced to create accounts. If they leave the password field blank, a secure password is generated and emailed to them automatically.

Can I combine billing and shipping fields?

Yes. Use “Combine Billing & Shipping” in Settings to merge them into one section. This also hides the “Ship to different address” checkbox.

What is Single Form Mode?

Single Form Mode combines all fields (billing, shipping, additional) into one unified tab for simplified management.

Can I reset to defaults?

Yes. Click “Reset to Defaults” at the bottom of the page to restore all fields to their original WooCommerce settings.

Does this plugin collect any data?

No. This plugin does not collect, transmit, or share any data with external servers. All settings and field data are stored locally in your WordPress database.
